summary: Warsh's Fed held rates at 3.50%-3.75% Wednesday but stripped easing-bias language from its statement and delivered a dot plot with a median year-end rate of 3.8%, signaling a hike is now the committee's central lean.   Stocks sold off into the close — the S&P 500 down 1.1%, the Dow off 410 points — while 2-year Treasury yields jumped 14 basis points to their highest in over a year.
tweet: Fed's dot plot now shows 9 members favoring a 2026 hike; stocks dropped, 2Y yields surged, and gold fell — before an Iran ceasefire deal lifted futures overnight.
